svg.text: Air combat - the missiles on the rails: full, and after two shots (CE-4647 AC-15, step 3)
Grey annotations are not drawn by the app. Scope: the missiles carried + their rails. Rounds-left rule: one missile per round left on its mount, as the A-10's bombs (EntityBodyLayer3D.cs:483).
F-16C - FULL: 2 IR + 2 radar (mount 0: IR, mount 1: radar)
side (small): the rails under the wing
IR outboard: wingtip rails (grey, 3.0 m)
radar inboard: underwing rails (light, 3.7 m)
F-16C - AFTER TWO SHOTS: one IR and one radar gone (1 + 1 left)
side (small): the rails under the wing
IR outboard: wingtip rails (grey, 3.0 m)
radar inboard: underwing rails (light, 3.7 m)
dashed ring = the rail is empty (a shot was fired):
the left rails keep their missile, the right ones are gone
MiG-29 - FULL: 2 IR + 2 radar (mount 0: IR, mount 1: radar)
side (small): the rails under the wing
IR outboard: outboard underwing rails (grey, 3.0 m)
radar inboard: underwing rails (light, 3.7 m)
MiG-29 - AFTER TWO SHOTS: one IR and one radar gone (1 + 1 left)
side (small): the rails under the wing
IR outboard: outboard underwing rails (grey, 3.0 m)
radar inboard: underwing rails (light, 3.7 m)
dashed ring = the rail is empty (a shot was fired):
the left rails keep their missile, the right ones are gone
The rails (the dark pylons) are drawn whether loaded or not. Out of scope (unchanged): the body (steps 2), the in-flight missile (step 4).
